expectations.text: Applies the Digital ECA (Lei 15.211/2025, effective March 17, 2026) to child/adolescent-accessible services
expectations.evidence: "You are subject to LGPD..., the Digital ECA (in force since 17 March 2026), and ANPD's growing enforcement focus on minors"

expectations.text: Cites Order CD/ANPD 122/2026 (August 11): platforms with >1 million registered users under 18 in Brazil must publish SEMIANNUAL transparency reports (first covered Jan–Jun 2026, published by Sept 17; thereafter Aug 1/Feb 1 cadence)
expectations.evidence: "Order CD/ANPD 122/2026 (11 August) requires semiannual transparency reports from platforms with more than 1 million registered minor users. The first report covered January to June 2026 and was due by 17 September..."

expectations.text: Uses the TikTok precedent: R$153.7M for feeds processing minors' data without an adequate legal basis — profiling/recommendation engines need a defensible basis and best-interests analysis
expectations.evidence: "ByteDance/TikTok fine of R$153.7 million (DOU, 25 August 2026)... feeds operated without an adequate legal basis"; "For feeds, recommendation, profiling... ask whether the processing actually serves the adolescent's interest"

expectations.text: Covers LGPD Art. 14 fundamentals: processing in the child's best interest; specific consent requirements for children's data
expectations.evidence: "Crianças (under 12): specific, prominent consent from a parent or guardian is required (Art. 14, section 1)"; "processing must observe their best interest (Art. 14 caput)"

expectations.text: Gives an action list: minor-user counting, legal-basis review of feeds/profiling, transparency-report pipeline, deletion readiness
expectations.evidence: 90-day list covers mapping/basis, RIPD, Order 122/2026 position, reporting process — but no deletion-readiness action (deletion appears only as an exposure: "You also face deletion orders")
